categories.main_business_segments: Kunshan Dongwei Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in high-end precision electroplating equipment manufacturing, focusing on three main sectors: PCB electroplating, general hardware surface treatment, and new energy electroplating. The company develops, designs, produces, and sells vertical continuous plating equipment, horizontal plating equipment, and related accessories, serving industries such as electronics, automotive, aerospace, and renewable energy.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technology centers on vertical continuous plating (VCP) with patented steel belt transmission systems enhancing plating uniformity and equipment lifespan. It employs advanced electrochemical etching, automated and modular production methods, and proprietary innovations like high aspect ratio plating, sealed plating tanks, and automated control systems. The firm also pioneers in vacuum sputtering and water electroplating for composite copper foil production in lithium batteries and photovoltaic copper plating replacing silver.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic PCB manufacturers, new energy battery producers, and general hardware manufacturers. End markets span high-performance computing, 5G communications, automotive electronics, semiconductor packaging, renewable energy (lithium batteries and photovoltaics), aerospace, and consumer electronics. The company serves both domestic and international clients, including notable global enterprises in Japan, Korea, Europe, and Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Kunshan, Guangdong, Anhui, and Jiangsu provinces, and has expanded overseas with a production facility in Thailand. Its sales and service network covers domestic markets predominantly, with growing exports to Europe, Southeast Asia, North America, Japan, Korea, and Taiwan.
categories.supply_chain_position: Dongwei Technology operates mainly in the midstream segment of the electroplating equipment supply chain, manufacturing and supplying high-end electroplating machinery and related technical services to downstream PCB manufacturers, hardware producers, and new energy material manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment focused on innovation in electroplating technologies, including vertical continuous plating, horizontal wet process equipment, and new energy applications like composite copper and aluminum foil plating. It pursues product upgrades, automation, environmental sustainability, and expansion into emerging markets such as lithium battery and photovoltaic sectors. Collaboration with universities and research institutes supports its technology leadership and patent portfolio growth.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of customized electroplating equipment and related services, including installation, maintenance, and spare parts. The company mainly uses direct sales complemented by limited distribution channels, with contracts typically involving staged payments tied to delivery, installation, and acceptance milestones.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Dongwei Technology holds a leading market position in China’s electroplating equipment industry, especially in vertical continuous plating with over 50% domestic market share. It competes with international and regional players such as Amtech (Germany), Jingming Machinery (Taiwan), and other Hong Kong and Taiwanese firms. The company differentiates itself through proprietary technologies, scale production, and expanding into new energy sectors, breaking foreign monopolies in certain equipment categories.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 750 million, a 17.5% decline from the previous year, mainly due to reduced demand in the new energy sector. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 69.3 million, down 54.25%. Despite short-term revenue contraction, the company maintains a solid asset base of RMB 2.7 billion and continues to invest heavily in R&D (over 11% of revenue). It has a workforce of about 1,400 employees and is expanding production capacity domestically and internationally.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Dongwei Technology offers high-efficiency, environmentally friendly, and intelligent electroplating solutions with superior plating uniformity, energy savings, and automation. Its patented steel belt transmission and vertical continuous plating technologies provide stable, high-quality plating with reduced maintenance costs. The company’s pioneering scale production of composite copper foil plating equipment for lithium batteries and advanced photovoltaic copper plating positions it uniquely as a technology leader with strong market recognition and customer trust.
